name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4-pixel focus ring with a 2-pixel offset around every interactive element. This makes keyboard navigation visible without shrinking touch targets or breaking reduced-motion users. The trade-off is a slight increase in visual noise, but it’s the only way to guarantee keyboard users can see where they are.

name: Reader
text: A 4-pixel focus ring risks blending into busy backgrounds or failing on low-contrast themes, making it invisible to some users. Instead, use a 3:1 contrast ratio against adjacent colors—this meets WCAG while keeping touch targets intact. Test with a screen reader user on a live build; if they can’t track focus, we adjust.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a 3:1 contrast ratio focus indicator—solid 2-pixel ring, 2-pixel offset—on every interactive element. This guarantees visibility for keyboard users without relying on color alone, so it works on busy backgrounds, low-contrast themes, and reduced-motion setups. The trade-off is a slightly thinner ring than the 4-pixel version, but it meets WCAG’s minimum contrast while keeping touch targets intact.

name: Reader
text: A 3:1 contrast ratio focus ring still risks blending into patterns or images behind interactive elements—WCAG only guarantees visibility against adjacent colors, not the full background. Instead, pair it with a 2-pixel *outer* glow (white or system highlight) to ensure the ring stands out regardless of background noise. Test with a screen reader user on a live build; if they can’t track focus in high-contrast or patterned UIs, the glow is the fix.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a **3px outset focus ring, 4.5:1 contrast, 2px spacing** with a **2px outer glow (system highlight)**—verify in live build with screen reader user. Owner: Ramp.
